sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroleth.

sentences.en: On Monday, as Nicolas Maduro and his wife Celia pleaded not guilty in a Manhattan courtroom,
sentences.zh: 周一，尼古拉斯·马杜罗和妻子西莉亚在曼哈顿法庭上做无罪抗辩时，

sentences.en: An era in which the United States appears to be the dominant force reshaping their once firmly anti-American government.

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Anatoly Kerminayev explains why President Trump chose to back a Maduro loyalist to run the country.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事阿纳托利·克尔米纳耶夫将解释为什么特朗普总统选择支持马杜罗的忠实追随者来管理国家。

sentences.en: And what Venezuelans think of it all.
sentences.zh: 以及委内瑞拉人对此有何看法。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, January 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月6日，星期二。

sentences.en: Hi, Anatoly.
sentences.zh: 嗨，阿纳托利。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎。

sentences.en: It's good to have you here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请，纳塔利。

sentences.en: So, in the last couple of days, we at the show have talked about how this operation to capture Nicolas Maduro went down.
sentences.zh: 那么，在过去几天里，我们节目一直在讨论逮捕尼古拉斯·马杜罗的这次行动是如何进行的。

sentences.en: We've talked about the legality of it.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了它的合法性。

sentences.en: What we haven't talked about as much is who is running Venezuela right now, and how is all of that going to play out?
sentences.zh: 我们没有讨论太多的是，现在究竟是谁在统治委内瑞拉，这一切又将如何收场？

sentences.en: Because that feels very uncertain in this moment.
sentences.zh: 因为此刻这一切感觉都非常扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: You've been in the country, as this all has been going on, through the mission itself.
sentences.zh: 这一切发生时，包括这次任务本身，你一直都在国内。

sentences.en: You're in Caracas right now.
sentences.zh: 你现在就在加拉加斯。

sentences.en: So, just to start, how does it feel there?
sentences.zh: 所以，先谈谈看，那里现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: It feels surreal.
sentences.zh: 感觉很不真实。

sentences.en: You know, the city is still coming out of Christmas holidays.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这座城市刚刚度过圣诞假期。

sentences.en: It's a metropolis of more than four million people, and it's full of lights and decorations.
sentences.zh: 这是一座拥有四百多万人口的大都市，到处都是灯光和装饰。

sentences.en: And I was driving through the city last night, and the city was completely deserted.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我开车穿过这座城市时，里面空无一人。

sentences.en: You know, there was not a single soul on the streets.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，街上连一个鬼影都没有。

sentences.en: It's no sounds to be made.
sentences.zh: 万籁俱寂。

sentences.en: It felt like I was in a zombie movie.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像身处丧尸电影中一样。

sentences.en: And I think it just sums up this atmosphere of expectation, of fear, of concern.
sentences.zh: 我想这正好概括了那种充满期待、恐惧和担忧的氛围。

sentences.en: It's just tense.
sentences.zh: 气氛非常紧张。

sentences.en: We have not seen mass signs of jubilation at the fall of Nicolas Maduro.
sentences.zh: 我们没有看到尼古拉斯·马杜罗倒台时那种大规模的狂欢庆祝。

sentences.en: At the same time, we have not seen any genuine mass outpourings of grieving for him and his wife.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们也没有看到任何人对他和他的妻子表现出真正的大规模悲痛。

sentences.en: And this atmosphere of quiet tension is taking place amid growing signs of repression, of people being detained, of journalists being harassed,
sentences.zh: 而在这种平静的紧张气氛中，镇压的迹象却越来越多，人们被拘留，记者受到骚扰，

sentences.en: which shows to me that even though this government has a new face,
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这表明尽管这个政府换了新面孔，

sentences.en: the brutal repressive apparatus that has kept it in power for decades remains in place and is cracking down again.
sentences.zh: 但那个几十年来维持其统治的残暴镇压机器依然存在，并且正在卷土重来。

sentences.en: It sounds like everyone in Venezuela is just kind of waiting with bated breath for what's to come.
sentences.zh: 听起来委内瑞拉的每个人都在屏息以待接下来的发展。

sentences.en: So let's get into that.
sentences.zh: 那我们就来深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: And my first question is, is what we're seeing actually regime change?
sentences.zh: 我的第一个问题是，我们看到的真的是政权更迭吗？

sentences.en: Because now that the dust has settled a little bit, it seems as though the regime is actually still in power in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 因为现在尘埃落定了一些，看起来委内瑞拉的政权其实依然在台上。

sentences.en: That's right, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 没错，纳塔利。

sentences.en: The regime is in place.
sentences.zh: 政权依然在。

sentences.en: The people who are no longer here is Maduro and his wife.
sentences.zh: 不在的人只有马杜罗和他的妻子。

sentences.en: And around 80 people have died between his Cuban bodyguards and Venezuelan civilians, Venezuelan security service members.
sentences.zh: 在他的古巴保镖、委内瑞拉平民以及委内瑞拉安全部门成员之间，大约有80人丧生。

sentences.en: But beyond that, we have seen the same cast of characters.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我们看到的还是原班人马。

sentences.en: Most of his inner circle is intact.
sentences.zh: 他大部分的核心圈子都完好无损。

sentences.en: It is in power and is led by Delcy Rodriguez, known universally as Delcy, who was Maduro's vice president, who was the first in line to replace him under any circumstances.
sentences.zh: 他们依然掌权，由德尔茜·罗德里格斯领导，大家都叫她德尔茜，她是马杜罗的副总统，也是任何情况下接替他的第一人选。

sentences.en: So the same characters are ruling the country.
sentences.zh: 所以统治这个国家的还是原来那些人。

sentences.en: OK, so Delcy Rodriguez, the vice president now in power, is someone that Trump has endorsed.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么现任副总统、如今当权的德尔茜·罗德里格斯是特朗普背书的人。

sentences.en: The administration says they're going to be working directly with her.
sentences.zh: 政府表示将直接与她合作。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about why.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈原因。

sentences.en: Why her?
sentences.zh: 为什么是她？

sentences.en: Because honestly, when you and I have talked about this,
sentences.zh: 因为说实话，当你我讨论这件事时，

sentences.en: the most obvious choice for who was going to work with the Trump administration in the event that Maduro was no longer in power was someone else.
sentences.zh: 在马杜罗下台的情况下，与特朗普政府合作的最明显人选其实是另一个人。

sentences.en: It was Maria Karina Machado, this famous opposition leader.
sentences.zh: 那就是著名的反对派领袖玛丽亚·科丽娜·马查多。

sentences.en: So explain for me, Anatoly, why it's not Machado and why it's Delcy instead.
sentences.zh: 所以请向我解释一下，阿纳托利，为什么不是马查多，而偏偏是德尔茜。

sentences.en: The short answer is continuity.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，是为了延续性。

sentences.en: Trump wanted to stop the flood of drugs from Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 特朗普希望阻止委内瑞拉毒品的泛滥。

sentences.en: He wanted to start off migrants.
sentences.zh: 他想要遏制移民。

sentences.en: But above all, he made it very clear he wanted Venezuelan oil.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，他明确表示他想要委内瑞拉的石油。

sentences.en: And Delcy Rodriguez has been able to sell herself as a reliable guardian of Venezuela's oil industry,
sentences.zh: 而德尔茜·罗德里格斯成功把自己包装成委内瑞拉石油工业可靠的守护者，

sentences.en: as a person who can manage Venezuela's resources and protect foreign interests, which in this case will be American investor interests.
sentences.zh: 一个能够管理委内瑞拉资源并保护外国利益的人，在这个案例中也就是美国投资者的利益。

sentences.en: And Machado was not able to sell herself as that figure?
sentences.zh: 而马查多没把自己包装成这样的人物吗？

sentences.en: She was not.
sentences.zh: 她没有。

sentences.en: And this is perhaps the biggest surprise of this theme.
sentences.zh: 这也许是这场风波中最让人意外的地方。

sentences.en: Machado is by far the most popular politician in the country.
sentences.zh: 马查多可以说是国内最受欢迎的政治家。

sentences.en: She has led an election campaign in 2024 that has led more than 70 percent of Venezuelans to vote for the opposition.
sentences.zh: 她在2024年领导了一场竞选活动，促使超过70%的委内瑞拉人投票给反对派。

sentences.en: And she has won the Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts.
sentences.zh: 她因自己的努力赢得了诺贝尔和平奖。

sentences.en: She has global recognitions and global respect.
sentences.zh: 她享有全球认可和全球尊重。

sentences.en: And she comes with impeccable conservative credentials.
sentences.zh: 而且她有着无可挑剔的保守派资历。

sentences.en: She's the daughter of a wealthy industrialiSt.
sentences.zh: 她是一位富商的女儿。

sentences.en: She has an impeccable record of supporting free markets, of supporting personal freedom, supporting Christian faith, all values at the heart of traditional Republican agenda.
sentences.zh: 她有着支持自由市场、支持个人自由、支持基督教信仰的无可挑剔的记录，这些全都是传统共和党议程核心的价值观。

sentences.en: But she's a product of a different period of American politics.
sentences.zh: 但她是美国政治不同时期的产物。

sentences.en: And Machado's greatest mistake was not being able to adapt to the transformation that Trump has brought to the American right.
sentences.zh: 马查多最大的失误在于无法适应特朗普带给美国右翼的变革。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that exactly?
sentences.zh: 你这话具体是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, the adjective that defines Machado more than anything else is consistency.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最能定义马查多的形容词就是始终如一。

sentences.en: She has been extremely consistent in her beliefs.
sentences.zh: 她的信仰极其坚定。

sentences.en: She has been extremely consistent in her political agenda.
sentences.zh: 她的政治议程极其一致。

sentences.en: And this consistency is what brought her to the cost of gaining power in Venezuela during the last elections.
sentences.zh: 正是这种始终如一让她在上届选举期间付出了获得委内瑞拉政权的代价。

sentences.en: This is the reasons why she has galvanized Venezuelan populations, because people believed in her.
sentences.zh: 这也是她能够激励委内瑞拉民众的原因，因为人们相信她。

sentences.en: They believed in her values.
sentences.zh: 他们相信她的价值观。

sentences.en: They believed in what she stood for and that she would defend them, that she would not negotiate with Maduro, that she would not sell them out.
sentences.zh: 他们相信她的立场，相信她会捍卫他们，相信她不会与马杜罗谈判，不会出卖他们。

sentences.en: This consistency was at its core.
sentences.zh: 这种始终如一是她的核心。

sentences.en: But in the current transactional Washington of today, this has become a liability.
sentences.zh: 但在如今这个讲究交易的华盛顿，这却成了一种负累。

sentences.en: She has not been able to adjust to a very transactional approach to politics that we see in Washington,
sentences.zh: 她没能适应我们在华盛顿看到的非常交易化的政治运作方式，

sentences.en: a ideologically agnostic approach to Washington where beliefs and policies are ditched and sacrificed and adjusted on daily basis to suit the whims of people taking power.
sentences.zh: 一种在意识形态上不置可否的华盛顿作风，在那里，信仰和政策为了迎合掌权者的奇思妙想而被每天抛弃、牺牲和调整。

sentences.en: And this has gradually led her to lose allies and make a growing number of enemies in the Trump administration,
sentences.zh: 这逐渐导致她失去了盟友，并在特朗普政府中树敌越来越多，

sentences.en: which eventually has contributed to her being sidelined at these crucial moments in Venezuelan history.
sentences.zh: 这最终导致她在委内瑞拉历史的这些关键时刻被边缘化。

sentences.en: OK, can you go a little deeper there?
sentences.zh: 好的，能再深入一点吗？

sentences.en: Like, give me examples of how she wasn't able to adjuSt.
sentences.zh: 比如，举几个她无法适应的例子。

sentences.en: So, for example, when Trump returns to power, his initial focus on Venezuela is getting Americans detained there, out of jail and back into the United States.
sentences.zh: 比如，当特朗普重返政坛时，他对委内瑞拉的初期重点是将被关押在那里的美国人弄出监狱并送回美国。

sentences.en: And he sends his envoy, he sends a man called Richard Grinnell, a businessman and former ambassador to Germany, to Caracas, to negotiate the deal.
sentences.zh: 他派出了他的特使，一个名叫理查德·格雷内尔的人，他是一名商人和前美国驻德国大使，前往加拉加斯谈判这笔交易。

sentences.en: And then Grinnell arrives in Caracas, he reaches out to Machado because she's the representative of Venezuelan opposition.
sentences.zh: 然后格雷内尔抵达加拉加斯，他联系了马查多，因为她是委内瑞拉反对派的代表。

sentences.en: She's seen at the time as representative of American intereSt.
sentences.zh: 当时她被视为美国利益的代表。

sentences.en: And he starts a dialogue, he starts a relationship that very quickly goes off the rails.
sentences.zh: 接着他展开了一场对话，开启了一段很快就脱轨的关系。

sentences.en: Because getting Americans out means talking to Maduro's government, means negotiating.
sentences.zh: 因为要把美国人救出来意味着跟马杜罗政府对话，意味着进行谈判。

sentences.en: Negotiating is an anathema for Maria Karina Machado.
sentences.zh: 谈判对玛丽亚·卡里娜·马查多来说是绝对无法接受的。

sentences.en: She has argued for decades that freedom is not negotiable, that democracy is not negotiable, that there can be no compromises.
sentences.zh: 几十年来她一直主张自由不容谈判，民主不容谈判，绝不能有任何妥协。

sentences.en: And that set the stage for a train wreck between Richard Grinnell and Maria Karina Machado,
sentences.zh: 这就为理查德·格里内尔和玛丽亚·卡里娜·马查多之间的一场灾难拉开了序幕，

sentences.en: a clash that has repeated itself over and over throughout the Trump administration as she lost natural allies and created new enemies.
sentences.zh: 这场冲突在特朗普政府执政期间一次又一次地上演，因为她失去了天然的盟友，树立了新的敌人。

sentences.en: You're saying basically Machado is such a purist that she's totally opposed to any notion of negotiating with Maduro.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，基本上马查多是一个纯粹主义者，她完全反对任何与马杜罗谈判的想法。

sentences.en: And this alienated Trump's lead negotiator in Venezuela, who's there to try to get a deal.
sentences.zh: 这就疏远了特朗普在委内瑞拉的首席谈判代表，他去那里是为了争取达成协议。

sentences.en: He was there to try to get a deal, and he's there to get economic deals.
sentences.zh: 他去那里是为了争取达成协议，也是为了争取经济协议。

sentences.en: He started negotiating a deal with Maduro's officials that would see Maduro hand over Venezuelan resources in return for him staying in power, at least for the time being.
sentences.zh: 他开始与马杜罗的官员谈判一项协议，该协议将让马杜罗交出委内瑞拉的资源，换取他继续掌权，至少目前是这样。

sentences.en: Again, this goes completely against everything that Machado has stood for.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，这完全违背了马查多一直以来所主张的一切。

sentences.en: And over time, in the months since the election, as Venezuelan government stepped up with repression,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，在选举之后的几个月里，委内瑞拉政府加大了镇压力度，

sentences.en: Machado's movement became increasingly marginalized in Venezuelan political life.
sentences.zh: 马查多的政治运动在委内瑞拉政治生活中日益被边缘化。

sentences.en: They increasingly had to flee in exile.
sentences.zh: 他们越来越不得不流亡海外。

sentences.en: Machado herself had to go into hiding.
sentences.zh: 马查多本人不得不躲藏起来。

sentences.en: They have gradually lost touch with what is happening on the streets in Venezuela, and their uncompromising position meant they had very few contacts inside Venezuelan government.
sentences.zh: 他们逐渐与委内瑞拉街头发生的事情脱节，他们毫不妥协的立场意味着他们在委内瑞拉政府内部几乎没有任何联系。

sentences.en: So then the Trump administration, they have gradually come to realize that the strategies that Machado and her aides were providing to Washington were outdated, were not accurate.
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普政府逐渐意识到，马查多及其助手向华盛顿提供的策略已经过时，并不准确。

sentences.en: And the intelligence or, you know, the assumptions being made by the opposition have proved wrong time and again.
sentences.zh: 反对派所持的情报，或者说各种假设，一次又一次地被证明是错误的。

sentences.en: And this has angered officials in the Trump administration that were trying to work out a credible plan of getting Maduro out of power.
sentences.zh: 这惹恼了特朗普政府中试图制定切实可行计划让马杜罗下台的官员。

sentences.en: So it sounds like they start to sour on her in part because they don't believe she's giving valuable intel.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来他们开始对她感到不满，部分原因是不相信她能提供有价值的情报。

sentences.en: And that's despite the fact that, as we know, in recent months,
sentences.zh: 尽管众所周知，就在最近几个月，

sentences.en: Machado was really doing everything she could to kind of ingratiate herself with the Trump administration as they began to dial up the pressure on Maduro.
sentences.zh: 随着特朗普政府开始对马杜罗施加压力，马查多确实竭尽所能来讨好特朗普政府。

sentences.en: She even dedicated her Nobel Peace Prize to Trump.
sentences.zh: 她甚至把自己的诺贝尔和平奖献给了特朗普。

sentences.en: I guess all that wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 我想这一切还不够。

sentences.en: All that wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 这一切还不够。

sentences.en: And to me, there's a certain tragic element to this because this is a politician with impeccable moral credentials.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这其中带有某种悲剧色彩，因为这是一个拥有无可挑剔的道德声誉的政治家。

sentences.en: Machado has built her presidential campaign on the focus on Venezuelan migrants, of reuniting Venezuelan families,
sentences.zh: 马查多的竞选活动聚焦于委内瑞拉难民、重聚委内瑞拉家庭，

sentences.en: of returning the millions of Venezuelans that have fled the country from Maduro, bringing them back home.
sentences.zh: 把因马杜罗而逃离该国的数百万委内瑞拉人接回国，带他们回家。

sentences.en: And since Trump took power, she has stopped talking about Venezuelan migrants because these are the people that Trump was arresting, Trump was deporting,
sentences.zh: 自从特朗普上台以来，她就再也不谈委内瑞拉难民了，因为这些人正是特朗普在抓捕、特朗普在驱逐的人，

sentences.en: Trump was jailing in foreign jails where they were tortured.
sentences.zh: 是特朗普把他们关在外国监狱并遭受酷刑的人。

sentences.en: And Machado stayed silent.
sentences.zh: 而马查多却保持沉默。

sentences.en: As flights into the country were gradually canceled under American pressure, she stayed silent.
sentences.zh: 在美国的压力下，飞往该国的航班逐渐被取消，她保持沉默。

sentences.en: As inflation rose under tightening American sanctions, complicating people's daily life, she has stayed silent.
sentences.zh: 随着美国日益收紧制裁导致通货膨胀上升、人们的日常生活变得复杂，她一直保持沉默。

sentences.en: And this has caused the political capital inside the country.
sentences.zh: 这付出了国内政治资本的代价。

sentences.en: She has sacrificed a lot of political goodwill that she has built inside Venezuela to please this one man.
sentences.zh: 为了取悦这一个人，她牺牲了她在委内瑞拉国内积累的大量政治商誉。

sentences.en: She has gone out of her way to praise him.
sentences.zh: 她不遗余力地赞扬他。

sentences.en: She has published op-eds saying that Trump is the greatest defender of freedom in the Western Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 她发表专栏文章称特朗普是西半球自由最伟大的捍卫者。

sentences.en: It was very clear to everyone observing Venezuela that Machado is speaking to the audience of one, and her entire strategy has been on bringing Trump to her side.
sentences.zh: 所有观察委内瑞拉局势的人都非常清楚，马查多是在迎合一个特定的观众，她的整个策略都押在把特朗普拉到自己这边来。

sentences.en: And so far, she has failed.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，她失败了。

sentences.en: You know, Trump said in this big press conference he gave over the weekend that Machado just didn't have the support in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普在周末召开的大型新闻发布会上说，马查多在委内瑞拉根本没有支持率。

sentences.en: So was that actually true, based on what you just said?
sentences.zh: 那么，根据你刚才所说，这真的是事实吗？

sentences.en: Credible polling in Venezuela is very limited, but the evidence we have shows that her popular support has been gradually, very slowly, sipping away from a very high point.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉可靠的民意调查非常有限，但我们掌握的证据表明，她的民众支持率一直在非常缓慢地从极高点逐渐流失。

sentences.en: Crucially for Trump, when he says that she doesn't have the respect, he is talking about respect to the people that would make it possible for her to govern.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普来说至关重要的是，当他说她没有受到尊重时，他指的是没有赢得那些能让她具备执政能力的人的尊重。

sentences.en: And Machado's inflexibility and focus on pressure rather than negotiation has meant that she has lost the support of Venezuela's economic elites that have traditionally supported their position.
sentences.zh: 马查多的不妥协以及她对施压而非谈判的聚焦，意味着她失去了委内瑞拉经济精英的支持，而这些精英历来都支持他们的立场。

sentences.en: Venezuela has for decades been informally governed by groups of rich businessmen who have among themselves divided Venezuelan economy.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，委内瑞拉一直由一群富商非正式地统治着，他们在内部瓜分了委内瑞拉的经济。

sentences.en: It was an old boys club for many decades.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这是一个老男孩俱乐部。

sentences.en: And these people had a natural repulsion to Chavismo and everything that stood for the people from the slums coming in, taking power and telling them what to do.
sentences.zh: 这些人对查韦斯主义以及平民从贫民窟涌入、掌权并对他们指手画脚的一切有着天生的排斥感。

sentences.en: But as time went on, things began to change.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，情况开始发生变化。

sentences.en: More and more captains of Venezuelan industry realized that if they wanted to continue working in Venezuela, they had to come to an understanding with the government.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的委内瑞拉工业巨头意识到，如果他们想继续在委内瑞拉工作，就必须与政府达成谅解。

sentences.en: They had to live with the government.
sentences.zh: 他们必须与政府共存。

sentences.en: And Machado's message is overhauling this completely, scrapping this whole system, is starting from scratch.
sentences.zh: 而马查多的信息是要彻底重组这一切，废除整个体制，从头开始。

sentences.en: And business wants stability and they turn against Machado's message of radical change.
sentences.zh: 商界需要稳定，于是他们转而反对马查多关于根本变革的信息。

sentences.en: While at the same time, she has not been able to gain the support or the armed forces that she herself has constantly said are crucial to removing Maduro.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，她一直未能赢得武装部队的支持，而她自己却一再声称武装部队对推翻马杜罗至关重要。

sentences.en: She has, again, to please Trump, she has gone out of a way to mimic his talking point that Venezuelan government is a narco cartel.
sentences.zh: 同样为了取悦特朗普，她不遗余力地模仿他的论调，称委内瑞拉政府是一个贩毒集团。

sentences.en: She has mimicked his language that Maduro is flooding the United States with drugs and criminals.
sentences.zh: 她模仿他的言论，称马杜罗正在向美国倾倒毒品和罪 criminals（罪犯）。

sentences.en: And this has meant that for the officers watching her speeches, for the members of the government, for the people that actually make the state tick and hold the guns,
sentences.zh: 这意味着对于观看她演讲的军官、政府成员、以及那些真正让国家运转并掌握枪杆子的人来说，

sentences.en: that she was painting them as members of a narco cartel, as part of a problem, as people that need to be eliminated from Venezuela's public life.
sentences.zh: 她把他们描绘成贩毒集团的成员、问题的一部分、以及需要被清除出委内瑞拉公共生活的人。

sentences.en: And the dissonance between her calls for the armed forces and government employees to rise up against Maduro and the way she has branded them as members of a narco cartel ended up spelling her political downfall inside the Venezuelan political system.
sentences.zh: 她一方面呼吁武装部队和政府雇员起义反对马杜罗，另一方面又将他们打上贩毒集团成员的烙印，这种不一致最终导致了她在委内瑞拉政治体制内的政治覆灭。

sentences.en: So, ironically, in order to align herself with Trump,
sentences.zh: 因此，具有讽刺意味的是，为了与特朗普保持一致，

sentences.en: Machado starts saying these things that actually alienate all these elites within Venezuela that she actually needs to have on board in order to persuade the Trump administration that she's a viable candidate to run the country.
sentences.zh: 马查多开始说这些话，而这些话实际上疏远了委内瑞拉国内的所有这些精英——而她实际上需要这些精英的支持，才能说服特朗普政府她是一个能够治理国家的合格候选人。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: That's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 这正是发生的事情。

sentences.en: These are people that have been in charge for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 这些人掌权已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration became convinced that to get the country running quickly, to keep it stable,
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府深信，要让国家快速运转、保持稳定，

sentences.en: to keep it from collapsing and sending hundreds of thousands of migrants to its borders, to keep the oil flowing to the United States, to boost that flow of oil,
sentences.zh: 防止国家崩溃并向其边界涌入数十万难民，保持石油流向美国、促进石油供应，

sentences.en: they needed to work with people who were already in charge.
sentences.zh: 他们就需要与已经在掌权的人合作。

sentences.en: And that's why we picked Delcy over Maria Karina Machado.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们选择了德尔茜而不是玛丽亚·卡里娜·马查多。

sentences.en: That's the great irony of the current political drama, that Delcy, despite of her Marxist roots,
sentences.zh: 这就是当前这场政治闹剧的最大讽刺之处，德尔茜尽管有着马克思主义的根基，

sentences.en: despite being the handpicked protégé of a person labeled as a narco-terrorist by the United States, despite playing a crucial part in a repressive machine,
sentences.zh: 尽管是被美国贴上“毒品恐怖分子”标签之人的精心挑选的门生，尽管在镇压机器中扮演了关键角色，

sentences.en: the White House has decided that she is the most likely candidate among the available options to bring Venezuela into the American sphere of influence.
sentences.zh: 白宫还是认定她在所有可选方案中最有可能是把委内瑞拉纳入美国势力范围的候选人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是威纳露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜游戏“连连看”的作者，我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作“拼字蜜蜂”和“信箱”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到声音的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 访问 games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Okay, let's talk about Venezuela's new leader, who, as you said, everyone calls Delcy.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来谈谈委内瑞拉的新领导人，正如你所说，大家都叫她德尔茜。

sentences.en: She sounds like an unlikely choice for the Trump administration in many ways to support.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，她听起来似乎不是特朗普政府支持的理想人选。

sentences.en: Explain who she is and what the Trump administration sees in her.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下她是谁，以及特朗普政府在她身上看到了什么。

sentences.en: First and foremost, they see Delcy as a capable economic manager, and that reputation that she has earned has come at the end of a very unexpected journey.
sentences.zh: 首先也是最重要的是，他们认为德尔茜是一位有能力的经济管理者，而她赢得这一声誉经历了一段非常意想不到的旅程。

sentences.en: She is the daughter of a Marxist guerrilla who was tortured by the security forces of the previous pro-American governments during the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲是一名马克思主义游击队员，在冷战期间曾遭到前亲美政府安全部队的酷刑折磨。

sentences.en: So she comes from a background of impeccable socialist credentials, but they also come from money.
sentences.zh: 所以她有着无可挑剔的社会主义背景，但他们也出身富裕。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And she enjoyed quite a privileged upbringing.
sentences.zh: 而且她度过了相当优渥的成长时期。

sentences.en: She went to university in France, and she joined the government, the current regime, under the wings of her older brother, going up in the ranks of the Chavismo government.
sentences.zh: 她在法国上大学，并在她哥哥的羽翼庇护下加入政府、即现政权，在查韦斯主义政府中步步高升。

sentences.en: And that rise really accelerated around 2019, when Venezuela was facing tremendous economic pressure from the United States that had just sanctions its oil industry.
sentences.zh: 这种崛起在大约 2019 年真正加速，当时委内瑞拉面临来自美国的巨大经济压力，美国刚刚对其实油行业实施了制裁。

sentences.en: The revenues have collapsed.
sentences.zh: 财政收入崩溃了。

sentences.en: The Maduro government has struggled to just keep the lights on in the country.
sentences.zh: 马杜罗政府苦苦挣扎，勉强维持着国家的电力供应。

sentences.en: And Maduro turns to Delcy and basically tells her to fix it.
sentences.zh: 于是马杜罗转向德尔茜，基本上告诉她去解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And what does she do?
sentences.zh: 她是怎么做的？

sentences.en: Does she fix it?
sentences.zh: 她解决了吗？

sentences.en: She completely re-engineers the Venezuelan economy.
sentences.zh: 她彻底重构了委内瑞拉经济。

sentences.en: She and a group of technocrats allied to her began a process that, in a very short period,
sentences.zh: 她和一群与她结盟的技术官僚开始了一个进程，在很短的时间内，

sentences.en: discarded the socialist tropes that the government had based its legitimacy on for many years,
sentences.zh: 抛弃了政府多年来用以确立合法性的社会主义陈词滥调，

sentences.en: price controls, currency controls, focus on the needs of the Venezuelan poor, and turned it into a free-for-all market economy where money ruled and investment was the only merit.
sentences.zh: 即价格管制、货币管制、专注于委内瑞拉穷人的需求，并将其转变为一个金钱至上、投资是唯一价值的市场经济。

sentences.en: It's so interesting that the daughter of a Marxist became this trusted steward of something approaching capitalist reform.
sentences.zh: 真有趣，一个马克思主义者的女儿竟然成了走向资本主义改革的值得信赖的管家。

sentences.en: Well, in many ways, you know, Venezuela is an extremely corrupt country.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在许多方面，你知道，委内瑞拉是一个极其腐败的国家。

sentences.en: And that is as corrupt today as it was under the nominally socialist principles.
sentences.zh: 现在的腐败程度与名义上的社会主义原则时期一样严重。

sentences.en: But in terms of actual policies, Delcy has turned Venezuela into a radically capitalist society that there is practically no regulation,
sentences.zh: 但在具体政策方面，德尔茜把委内瑞拉变成了一个激进的资本主义社会，那里几乎没有任何监管，

sentences.en: that there are practically no rules, that money is the only variable that governs society and governs the interaction between the states and its citizens.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有任何规则，金钱是主导社会以及主导国家与公民之间互动的唯一变量。

sentences.en: But did it work, though?
sentences.zh: 但它起作用了吗？

sentences.en: Like, did it stabilize the economy, which is what Maduro was originally asking for?
sentences.zh: 比如说，它稳定了经济吗？这正是马杜罗最初要求的。

sentences.en: It did work and led to a period of moderate growth.
sentences.zh: 它确实起作用了，并带来了一段温和的增长期。

sentences.en: Starting in 2021, the inflation subsided.
sentences.zh: 从 2021 年开始，通货膨胀有所消退。

sentences.en: People started to open up businesses.
sentences.zh: 人们开始做生意。

sentences.en: People started to travel more.
sentences.zh: 人们开始更多地旅行。

sentences.en: The oil production began to gradually edge up.
sentences.zh: 石油产量开始逐渐上升。

sentences.en: And remember, Natalie, that this has all started from a very low base.
sentences.zh: 记住，娜塔莉，这一切都是从一个非常低的基数开始的。

sentences.en: We're not talking about Dubai or Latin America.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的不是迪拜或拉丁美洲（其它国家）。

sentences.en: But we're talking about a country that had suffered a tremendous economic collapse, where millions have fled, that people have suffered from malnutrition.
sentences.zh: 而是谈论一个遭受过巨大经济崩溃、数百万人逃亡、人们遭受营养不良的国家。

sentences.en: And it gave them a modicum of economic stability.
sentences.zh: 这给他们带来了一点经济上的稳定。

sentences.en: Okay, so it sounds like the reforms that Delcy helped engineer, they didn't, you know, bring wealth back en masse to Venezuelans.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听起来德尔茜协助设计的改革并没有给委内瑞拉人带来大规模的财富，

sentences.en: But they did right the economic ship.
sentences.zh: 但它们确实扶正了经济之船。

sentences.en: They helped stanch the bleeding.
sentences.zh: 它们帮助止住了流血。

sentences.en: Did that do anything to help the regime's standing with Venezuelans?
sentences.zh: 这有没有对提升该政权在委内瑞拉人中的地位起到任何作用？

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, they still voted for the opposition in the last election.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，显然他们在上次选举中仍然投票给反对派。

sentences.en: So I would imagine the answer is no, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我猜答案是否定的，对吧？

sentences.en: The answer is no.
sentences.zh: 答案是否定的。

sentences.en: And the elections of 2024 have proven that.
sentences.zh: 2024 年的选举已经证明了这一点。

sentences.en: The government had gone out of its way to sell itself to Venezuelan as we are stability.
sentences.zh: 政府不遗余力地向委内瑞拉人推销自己：我们代表稳定。

sentences.en: The opposition is chaos.
sentences.zh: 反对派代表混乱。

sentences.en: Stick with us.
sentences.zh: 支持我们。

sentences.en: You can live with us.
sentences.zh: 你可以和我们一起生活。

sentences.en: You can breathe with us.
sentences.zh: 你可以和我们一起呼吸。

sentences.en: And still, more than 70% of Venezuelans, including massive proportions of public sector workers and the poor, voted for their position,
sentences.zh: 即便如此，仍有超过 70% 的委内瑞拉人，包括很大一部分公共部门工人和穷人，投票支持反对派，

sentences.en: voted for the candidate of Maria Karina Machado, showing just the scale of exhaustion and repulsion that this population has against President Maduro.
sentences.zh: 投票支持玛丽亚·卡里娜·马查多的候选人，这显示了这个民众群体对马杜罗总统的疲惫和排斥到了何种程度。

sentences.en: And what about the elites that we talked about earlier?
sentences.zh: 那我们之前谈到的精英们呢？

sentences.en: How do they see Delcy in all of this?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么看待德尔茜的？

sentences.en: Delcy's reforms gave them space to grow, gave them space to inveSt.
sentences.zh: 德尔茜的改革为他们提供了发展的空间，为他们提供了投资的空间。

sentences.en: Again, not talking about massive investments.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，我们谈论的不是巨额投资。

sentences.en: We're not talking about tremendous growth.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的不是惊人的增长。

sentences.en: We're talking about a climate where people that have money can start making more money.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是一个有钱人可以开始赚更多钱的环境。

sentences.en: It's really interesting, right?
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，对吧？

sentences.en: Because Machado, in many ways, is a more natural ally of theirs, too, right?
sentences.zh: 因为在许多方面，马查多对他们来说也是一个更自然的盟友，对吧？

sentences.en: She comes from this family they probably know, this industrialiSt.
sentences.zh: 她来自这个他们可能认识的实业家家庭。

sentences.en: She has these impeccable credentials as a free market capitaliSt.
sentences.zh: 她拥有无可挑剔的自由市场资本主义者身份。

sentences.en: And yet, here, she's the one with the broad-based popular support who's lost the support of these elites.
sentences.zh: 然而在这里，她才是那个拥有广泛民众基础却失去了这些精英支持的人。

sentences.en: While Delcy doesn't have that popular support, it sounds like, but she has one over this group of business titans that is still incredibly influential in this country.
sentences.zh: 而德尔茜虽然没有这种民众支持，但听起来她赢得了这群在这个国家仍然具有极高影响力的商业巨头的心。

sentences.en: This is a fundamental paradox, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 这是一个根本性的悖论，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: I could not have summarized it better.
sentences.zh: 我再怎么总结也不过如此了。

sentences.en: And I think all it just goes to show that economic freedoms do not always correlate with political freedoMs.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一切都表明，经济自由并不总是与政治自由成正比。

sentences.en: And the reality is that, for Trump, what matters to him is the deals and the investments of the elites.
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，对特朗普来说，对他重要的是交易和精英们的投资。

sentences.en: And that has led him to gradually ally with Delcy, the self-styled technocrat who could bring him Venezuelan riches over Maria Karina Machado,
sentences.zh: 这导致他逐渐与德尔茜结盟——这位自封的技术官僚能为他带来委内瑞拉的财富，而不是玛丽亚·卡里娜·马查多，

sentences.en: who was promising political liberation, but a very volatile and unstable economic environment.
sentences.zh: 后者虽然承诺政治解放，但带来的却是一个非常动荡和不稳定的经济环境。

sentences.en: Okay, so now I think I get why Delcy is preferable to Machado in the eyes of Trump.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我想我明白为什么在特朗普眼里德尔茜比马查多更合适了。

sentences.en: What I still don't understand, though, is why Delcy is preferable to Maduro.
sentences.zh: 不过我仍然不明白的是，为什么德尔茜比马杜罗更合适。

sentences.en: Because you've told us, Anatoly, the few times that you've come on to talk about this, that Maduro was actually happy to let the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为阿纳托利，你在过去几次受邀谈论此事时告诉过我们，马杜罗实际上很乐意让美国

sentences.en: into Venezuela's oil fields, to give up those natural resources as part of a potential deal with Trump.
sentences.zh: 进入委内瑞拉的油田，作为与特朗普达成潜在协议的一部分，交出这些自然资源。

sentences.en: Why did Trump reject that, only to go for what sounds like a very similar deal with Delcy?
sentences.zh: 为什么特朗普拒绝了那个提议，转而接受了一个听起来与德尔茜非常相似的协议？

sentences.en: I don't think we have perfect clarity to that question at the moment, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，我觉得我们目前对这个问题还没有完全清晰的认识。

sentences.en: My hunch is that the campaign against Maduro, the campaign to brand them a narco-terrorist and a cartel chief who is at war with the United States,
sentences.zh: 我的直觉是，针对马杜罗的运动——即把他打上毒品恐怖分子和与美国交战的贩毒集团头目的烙印——

sentences.en: has gone simply too far for Trump to tolerate him and make a deal with him.
sentences.zh: 已经走得太远了，以至于特朗普无法容忍他并与他达成协议。

sentences.en: Remember that while oil is the driving force of Trump's policy towards Venezuela, it's not the only one.
sentences.zh: 请记住，虽然石油是特朗普对委内瑞拉政策的驱动力，但它并不是唯一的驱动力。

sentences.en: And there are advisors within his administration, there are people in his administration that are pushing towards our goals.
sentences.zh: 在他的政府内部有顾问，也有一些人正在推动我们的目标。

sentences.en: There's Stephen Miller with his focus on migration and illegal drugs.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·米勒专注于移民和非法药物。

sentences.en: There's Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who has been a declared anti-communist warrior.
sentences.zh: 还有国务卿马可·鲁比奥，他一直是一位公开的反共斗士。

sentences.en: These people have been sworn enemies of Maduro.
sentences.zh: 这些人一直是马杜罗的死敌。

sentences.en: And as Maduro repeatedly rebuffs Trump administration's attempts to provide him a soft landing, to provide him a golden parachute, Trump's position hardens.
sentences.zh: 随着马杜罗一再回绝特朗普政府为他提供软着陆、提供金色降落伞的企图，特朗普的立场也随之强硬起来。

sentences.en: And by December, his patience finally snaps.
sentences.zh: 到了十二月，他的耐心终于耗尽了。

sentences.en: Maduro's response to increasingly explicit ultimatums from America was to present himself as a carefree partier.
sentences.zh: 面对美国日益明确的最后通牒，马杜罗的回应是将自己包装成一个无忧无虑的派对爱好者。

sentences.en: He constantly dances on television.
sentences.zh: 他在电视上不停地跳舞。

sentences.en: He sings, no crazy war.
sentences.zh: 他唱歌，没有疯狂的战争。

sentences.en: You know, he's a good dancer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是个好舞者。

sentences.en: You know, he puts up the moves and, you know, he does on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他摆出舞姿，而且，你知道，他经常这么做。

sentences.en: And at some point, Trump snaps.
sentences.zh: 而在某个时刻，特朗普崩溃了。

sentences.en: Wait, are you saying, Anatoly, that Maduro dancing on national television is an actual factor here in everything that ends up happening?
sentences.zh: 等等，阿纳托利，你是说马杜罗在国家电视台跳舞，实际上是导致这一切最终发生的一个因素吗？

sentences.en: My understanding, it was the straw that broke the camel's back.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，那是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: Meaning what exactly?
sentences.zh: 具体是什么意思？

sentences.en: That Trump saw Maduro dancing and said, this guy's not taking me seriously?
sentences.zh: 是说特朗普看到马杜罗跳舞，然后说这家伙没把我当回事？

sentences.en: Or what?
sentences.zh: 还是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Meaning that Trump saw the ongoing dancing as a humiliation, as Maduro calling Trump's bluff, as Maduro telling Trump, I'm here and I'm here for as long as I want to be.
sentences.zh: 意思是特朗普将持续的跳舞视为一种羞辱，视为马杜罗在叫板特朗普，视为马杜罗在告诉特朗普：“我就在这里，而且只要我想，我想呆多久就呆多久。”

sentences.en: And Trump could not tolerate what he saw as a personal affront.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普无法容忍他所认为的对自己的公然羞辱。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: We are truly living in wild times.
sentences.zh: 我们真的生活在一个疯狂的时代。

sentences.en: Remember, I mean, Anatoly, history is often made by seemingly sort of small, banal circumstances, right?
sentences.zh: 记住，我的意思是，阿纳托利，历史往往是由看似微小、平庸的环境所塑造的，对吧？

sentences.en: It's an accumulation of major factors, major forces like oil, migration, drugs.
sentences.zh: 这是各种主要因素、主要力量的积累，比如石油、移民、毒品。

sentences.en: But, you know,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，

sentences.en: it can be something as sort of small as a little techno dance on a public stage that can tilt the scares towards a momentous policy decision that will change the history of Western Hemisphere,
sentences.zh: 它也可能是像在公众舞台上跳的一小段电音舞那样微不足道的事情，却能使天平倾斜，导向一项将改变西半球历史的重大政策决定，

sentences.en: perhaps forever.
sentences.zh: 也许永远改变。

sentences.en: Okay, we'll have plenty of time to talk about that future.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们有充足的时间来讨论那个未来。

sentences.en: But for now, the Trump administration is counting on Delci.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，特朗普政府正指望德尔茜。

sentences.en: And this is someone who, in the last few days, has come out very strongly against them, it's worth saying.
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，就在过去几天里，这个人公开表现出对他们的强烈反对。

sentences.en: She said Maduro is the only president of Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 她说马杜罗是委内瑞拉唯一的总统。

sentences.en: She refers to herself as the vice president.
sentences.zh: 她自称为副总统。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering what we should make of that.
sentences.zh: 我在想我们该如何理解这一点。

sentences.en: I know that there are a lot of people from the regime that are still in power in the country.
sentences.zh: 我知道国内仍有许多来自该政权的人在掌权。

sentences.en: And I wonder if this is her playing to them, to that domestic audience.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否是她在演给他们看，演给国内的受众看。

sentences.en: She has to appease them, right?
sentences.zh: 她必须安抚他们，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Remember that the attack was a major humiliation to the armed forces and security officials that form the core of Maduro's regime.
sentences.zh: 请记住，这次袭击对构成马杜罗政权核心的武装部队和安全官员来说是一种巨大的羞辱。

sentences.en: It was an operation that cost the lives of 80 people, causing major destructions in capital Caracas.
sentences.zh: 那是一场夺去80人生命、并对首都加拉加斯造成重大破坏的行动。

sentences.en: Delci could not just sort of wave this off and open her arms to Americans.
sentences.zh: 德尔茜不可能就这样挥挥手把这事揭过去，然后向美国人敞开双臂。

sentences.en: You know, she has to satisfy the domestic audience.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她必须满足国内受众的要求。

sentences.en: She has to show to the ruling party's faithful, who are not numerous in numbers, but who hold a lot of guns, that she's not an American pawn.
sentences.zh: 她必须向执政党的忠诚信徒们——虽然人数不多，但手里握有很多枪支——证明她不是美国的傀儡。

sentences.en: That she's someone who will defend the country's sovereignty, someone who will defend the country's standing.
sentences.zh: 证明她是一个会捍卫国家主权、会捍卫国家地位的人。

sentences.en: While at the same time, she has to satisfy American demands.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，她必须满足美国的要求。

sentences.en: You know, the Trump administration and his officials have repeatedly stated that Delci must do their bidding or else she will face the same fate as Maduro.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普政府及其官员一再表示，德尔茜必须听从他们的吩咐，否则她将面临与马杜罗相同的命运。

sentences.en: So she's trying to play for both audiences.
sentences.zh: 所以她正试图两边讨好。

sentences.en: And as you said, she started off making very sort of aggressive remarks towards America.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，她一开始对美国发表了非常具有攻击性的言论。

sentences.en: But just in a matter of days, in a matter of hours, her position has softened.
sentences.zh: 但就在短短几天、短短几小时内，她的立场软化了。

sentences.en: She has issued a statement calling for corporations with the United States, for peaceful coexistence, for working together, for joint business ventures.
sentences.zh: 她发表了一份声明，呼吁与美国合作、和平共处、共同努力以及开展合资企业。

sentences.en: And just let it sink for you, Natalie, this is a statement towards the government that has just blown up your capital and killed 80 people living in the capital.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，你好好体会一下，这是一份针对刚刚炸毁了你的首都、并杀害了住在首都的80人的政府发出的声明。

sentences.en: And you are basically opening your arms to their investments and to bilateral relations.
sentences.zh: 而你基本上是在向他们的投资和双边关系敞开双臂。

sentences.en: No, it's totally remarkable.
sentences.zh: 不，这真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And it makes me want to ask you about what this means for the Chavista movement that has been in power now for almost three decades in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 这让我想问你，这对于在委内瑞拉执政已经将近三十年的查韦斯主义运动意味着什么。

sentences.en: This is a movement that has staked its legacy on being an anti-American bulwark.
sentences.zh: 这是一个将自己的历史遗产押注在成为反美堡垒上的运动。

sentences.en: What happens to that legacy if Delci follows through and really does become a willing partner of the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 如果德尔茜说到做到，真的成了特朗普政府的乐意合作的伙伴，那这份遗产会怎样？

sentences.en: To me, Natalie, the events of the past few days exposed the hollowness of the nationalist rhetoric behind the Chavismo movement.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，在我看来，过去几天的事件暴露了查韦斯主义运动背后民族主义言辞的空洞。

sentences.en: And at the time when the country came into the attack, no one was prepared to defend President Maduro.
sentences.zh: 在国家遭到袭击的时候，没有人准备好防卫马杜罗总统。

sentences.en: There was no notable resistance from young forces.
sentences.zh: 年轻力量没有表现出任何明显的抵抗。

sentences.en: And to me, this peels another layer of mysticism and ideology from the movements.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这为该运动剥去了又一层神秘主义和意识形态的外衣。

sentences.en: Over the years, over the decades, this movement has gradually lost the pillars of its ideology.
sentences.zh: 多年来，几十年来，这场运动逐渐失去了其意识形态的支柱。

sentences.en: First, it lost the populist support.
sentences.zh: 首先，它失去了民粹主义的支持。

sentences.en: Then it lost the socialist credentials.
sentences.zh: 然后它失去了社会主义的信誉。

sentences.en: Now it loses nationalism.
sentences.zh: 现在它失去了民族主义。

sentences.en: And what is left, Natalie?
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，还剩下什么？

sentences.en: Survival.
sentences.zh: 生存。

sentences.en: Survival is the core aspects of Chavismo movements.
sentences.zh: 生存是查韦斯主义运动的核心方面。

sentences.en: And the senior officials who have been at Maduro's side for years and have now closing ranks behind Delci are focused on survival at any coSt.
sentences.zh: 多年来一直陪伴在马杜罗身边、现在又紧紧团结在德尔茜身后的高官们，正不惜一切代价专注于生存。

sentences.en: And Atoli, I want to end by just asking how the Venezuelans you're talking to are perceiving all of this, how they're feeling right now.
sentences.zh: 阿纳托利，我想在最后问一下，你所交谈的委内瑞拉人是如何看待这一切的，他们现在感觉如何。

sentences.en: I have to imagine that the many people who voted against Maduro are happy that he's gone on the one hand.
sentences.zh: 我禁不住想象，一方面，许多投票反对马杜罗的人很高兴他下台了。

sentences.en: And yet, the regime that he led is still very much there.
sentences.zh: 然而，他所领导的政权依然完好存在。

sentences.en: And not only that, now there's also this added element of Trump having a potentially very heavy hand in their country.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，现在还多了一个因素，即特朗普可能会对他们的国家施加非常重大的影响。

sentences.en: So how is that playing with people?
sentences.zh: 那么人们对此作何感想？

sentences.en: This is a country that has gotten used to disappointments, that has gotten used to tragedy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个已经习惯了失望、习惯了悲剧的国家。

sentences.en: In the years that I have lived here, I have experienced time and again a moment of extreme exaltation when it appeared that freedom and democracy were just within grasp.
sentences.zh: 在我住在这里的几年里，我一次又一次地经历过这样的时刻：当自由和民主似乎触手可及之时，人们会感到极度的狂喜。

sentences.en: You know, I have witnessed millions of people come out on the streets in popular protest against the government.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我曾亲眼目睹数百万人走上街头，举行抗议政府的群众游行。

sentences.en: And every time that hope, that democracy, that freedom was snatched from under their nose.
sentences.zh: 而每一次，那种希望、那种民主、那种自由都在他们的眼皮底下被夺走。

sentences.en: This is a country that has been burned many times and where people have learned to temper their expectations.
sentences.zh: 这是一个饱受创伤的国家，这里的人民已经学会了调低他们的期望值。

sentences.en: And I think most people in Venezuela, when they watch Delci being sworn in as the country's interim president, this is not the outcome they would have hoped for.
sentences.zh: 我认为委内瑞拉的大多数人在看着德尔茜宣誓就任该国临时总统时，这并不是他们所希望的结果。

sentences.en: This is not the outcome they would have chosen.
sentences.zh: 这不是他们会选择的结果。

sentences.en: This is an outcome, but it's not just, but it's not fair, but it's an outcome that just might make their difficult life just a little bit easier.
sentences.zh: 这是一个结果，虽然它并不完美，也不那么公正，但它可能让他们的艰难生活变得稍微容易那么一点点。

sentences.en: Well, Anatoly, I hope you get some rest in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 好的，阿纳托利，希望你在接下来的几天里能好好休息一下。
